description: Costs 1 credit, +1 if more than 10 steps. Runs a sequence of actions — click, type, select, scroll, wait, navigate, pressKey, assert — and returns the final page plus a per-step pass/fail report. Call domscout_inspect_page first to find selectors. Requires Pro or above. The whole sequence shares a 24-second budget.

actions.description: Up to 25 steps, run in order.

expected.description: For assert: exists, visible, checked, enabled, text:VALUE, equals:VALUE.

text.description: Text to type, or to wait for.

extractMarkdown.description: Return the final page as Markdown.

screenshot.description: Return an image of the final state.

url.description: The page to load. Must be http(s) and publicly reachable. Credentials in the URL (https://user:pass@host) are rejected; these tools capture as an anonymous visitor, so use the REST API directly if the page needs authentication.

name: domscout_automate_page
title: Click, type, and navigate on a page, then capture the result
